title: Watch_Dogs (USA) (En,Fr,Es,Pt)
result: English voices and English text. The disc has no Japanese voices. The French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese voice data is removed.

ops.why: Each language has one sound bank: sound_<language>.dat (about 1.65 GB) with its index sound_<language>.fat. The index files stay, so the game still finds every file; only the data of the unused languages becomes zeros.
The city has one 19 MB localized bank per language, with the same layout as the sound banks.

tested.device: AYN Thor, CHD on the SD card
tested.result: Not play-tested. The CHD opens and the EBOOT decrypts, but the first boot dies in the cold PPU compile (Scudo: 'exhausted 256M for size class 262160', LLVM JIT thread), also with ppu_budget_mb=1536. The original image has the same compile, so test the recipe after that bug is fixed.
